title: PartyRoster
description: Version 1: the game's party roster (decision 0014 M5.4d). Every member's battle stats, reach and frame, their default cell on the party's 3 × 3 grid, and which members start in the party. Saves keep the members in the party and each one's cell; a save without them takes these defaults.

active.description: The members in the party at the start, in party order (up to four). Their default cells must not overlap.

reach.description: melee: front-facing targets only; reach (spears, whips, polearms): one layer deeper; ranged (bows, spells): anyone. Default melee.

cell.description: Default grid cell. lane: 1 top to 3 bottom; depth: 1 front to 3 back.
